name: In The Hours of Darkness
summary:
Enter the world of In The Hours of Darkness, an action-adventure 2D game, set in a city where magic is commonplace, and danger and wonder lurk in each corner.

As unemployed artist Rex Nemo, explore the City of Shores as you try to solve the riddle of a magic book, before its too late. Use acrobatic skill, combat prowess, and an assortment of spells in order to outsmart your foes and unlock the secrets of the City.
